Hi all — quick legal take after reviewing WhiteOak's high-level dataflow:

1) Recommended execution: Module 2 (Controller -> Processor) SCCs for EU transfers. This matches the operational relationship: WhiteOak as controller, Redwood as processor.
2) UK transfers: we will attach the UK Addendum to the SCCs. Our playbook suggests bundling the EU SCCs + UK Addendum in one execution packet for speed.
3) DPA alignment: we'll map the SCC Obligations to our DPA clauses in the cover sheet and provide a mapping table for their legal team. That helps speed review cycles.
4) Subprocessors: include our subprocessor list as an appendix; we should confirm whether WhiteOak requires prior approval or simple notification (procurement will advise).

Action items for this thread (I recommend):
- Redwood Legal to send redline of the standard SCCs (Module 2) + UK Addendum to WhiteOak legal by EOD 2026-09-23.
- Include a mapping document (SCC obligations -> DPA sections) and our current subprocessor spreadsheet.
- Offer a two-week signature window; if WhiteOak needs earlier, we can prioritize execs.

I've prepared an internal draft and a short playbook note (redwood-sccs-playbook-v2.md). Attaching draft for internal review.

Marissa Cole
Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
